# Aviation Law: The Hard Stop Sequence

Sign the Scholarship & Guarantor Contracts.

Book Flights, Apply for
Visas, Buy Insurance.

Do NOT book flights or apply for
visas before signing.
Do NOT purchase travel insurance
before signing.

**NO EXCEPTIONS. If you bypass this sequence and spend money before the contract is signed, the university cannot reimburse you under any circumstances.**

Contract Liabilities & Medical Exemptions

(Requires medical certificate from a public hospital)

1. Non-invasive cancer
2. Invasive cancer
3. Major Stroke
4. Chronic Kidney Failure
5. Severe COPD / End-stage
Lung Disease
6. Acute Heart Attack
7. Fulminant Viral Hepatitis

Abandoning or breaching the
contract requires submitting
Form P.13.

Must return ALL funds within
30 days.

Late returns incur a 5%
interest rate per year.
